## Design note

Twelve tonnes empty, and it still has to stop for the lights. The heaviest thing on the road: slow to 100 and done at 110, it brakes in stages and corners like a building. Anything that hits it bounces off; anything it hits is scrap.

## How this car breaks

Deep steel frame rails with a heavy steel bumper and a steel dump body: frontal and rear hits bend the bumper and grille, then stop. The cab is an ordinary steel truck cab on mounts, so a hit above frame height goes into it, and the steer axle, its wheels and the side-saddle tank are the parts a car can actually break.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for 2010s tri-axle dump trucks (unladen)
- manufacturer spec-class data for 11 L heavy-duty diesel sixes
- engineering tables (commercial tire radius, leaf-spring ride frequency, S-cam air brake torque)

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| roll | 17142 | 0.85 | 14570 |
| pitch | 71738 | 0.95 | 68150 |
| yaw | 67098 | 0.97 | 65080 |

Peak **296 kW @ 1700 rpm**, **1966 N·m @ 1100 rpm**. Idle 600 / redline 2000 / limiter 2100 rpm. Rotating inertia 1.40 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 20% of peak torque = 393 N·m. Power-to-weight 25 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

6-speed automatic with torque converter (vocational), open inter-axle and rear diffs on the tandem; top speed set by the limiter in 6th (fleet governor). Layout **RWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Torque converter: stall 1500 rpm, 2.0× at stall, couples 1:1 from 1800 rpm (class-typical for the gearbox). Clutch capacity 1.50 × peak torque = 2950 N·m. Shift time 0.45 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 4.70 | 24.86 | 15 |
| 2 | 2.21 | 11.69 | 32 |
| 3 | 1.53 | 8.09 | 47 |
| 4 | 1.00 | 5.29 | 71 |
| 5 | 0.76 | 4.02 | 94 |
| 6 | 0.67 | 3.54 | 107 |

Final drive 5.29, reverse 5.55. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.501 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.28 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 2510 kg | 1.70 Hz | 286400 N/m | 15020 N·s/m | 22530 N·s/m | 0.18 m |
| Rear | 2740 kg | 1.90 Hz | 390500 N/m | 18320 N·s/m | 27480 N·s/m | 0.18 m |

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.5°/g with 55% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 1.148 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 2213334 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 619558 F / 653954 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **138200 F / 102100 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.5°/g, front share 55%. Bump stops 2500000 N/m.

Alignment: camber +0.0° F / +0.0° R, toe +0.10° F / +0.00° R (+ = in), caster 4.0°.

## Brakes

Air brakes: full-application chamber pressure 6.9 bar.

- Front: 419 mm air S-cam drum, type-30 chamber (A = 194 cm²), 140 mm slack adjuster, cam gain 8.0 (drum torque / camshaft torque, includes lining μ): T = p·A·L·G = 6.9 bar·194 cm²·0.140 m·8.0 = 14957 N·m per wheel end = **14957 N·m**
- Rear: 419 mm air S-cam drum, type-30 chamber (A = 194 cm²), 140 mm slack adjuster, cam gain 8.0 (drum torque / camshaft torque, includes lining μ): T = p·A·L·G = 6.9 bar·194 cm²·0.140 m·8.0 = 14957 N·m per wheel end × 2 ends (tandem lumped into one physics wheel) = **29915 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 21653 N·m/wheel (capacity 0.69×), rear needs 8476 N·m/wheel (capacity 3.53×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 5856 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.836** → delivered 14960 N·m front / 5868 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 14960 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 22.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 17.5 m → outer-front path radius 8.59 m, rear-axle-centre radius 5.98 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.691 rad (39.6°)** (outer 35.2°, inner 45.0° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.80). Rack speed 0.9 rad/s.

## Damage lattice (`data/lattices/quarry_tipper.json`)

338 nodes, 2071 beams, 6 detachables, 21 component mounts.

- Generated with `gen-lattice --id quarry_tipper --profile truck --width 2.5 --length 7.8 --height 3.3 --wheelbase 4.95 --mass 2640.3 --car-mass 12001.4 --clearance 0.4 --front-overhang 1.25 --strength 1.3` (22% of vehicle mass in the lattice; strength from durability class 5).
- Era `2010s`: gen-lattice's default HSS passenger cell kept as is.
- Steel hood: 159 hood beams aluminum → mild_steel.
- Chrome steel bumpers: 180 bumper beams pp_bumper → mild_steel.
- Detachables: steel bumpers ×2.3 break impulse / ×4 mass; steel hood ×1.4 / ×1.6.
- Body-on-frame: 18 cab-floor rail nodes relabelled FrameLeft/FrameRight; 16 under-cab rail beams → hss 1.90e-03 m² so the ladder frame runs bumper to bumper.
- Side-saddle fuel tank outboard of the left frame rail between cab and rear axle.
